anya (Docs): Quick ask "> 2 mins": can we get a tiny migration note + 3 short snippets (SDK, CLI, Terraform) for the Optimize toolkit page about switching to 4-bit profiles + microbatch rename? Target: tiny PR.

mike (Eng-runtime): Yep. Key callouts: `batch_sz` -> `microbatch`, and runtime may fallback to 8bit if a 4-bit kernel isn't available. Snippet below.

Mike (Eng-runtime): SDK (v0.13) 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient()
resp = rc.generate(model='rwd/llama-13b', microbatch=6, quant_profile='4bit-gamma')
print(resp.text)
```

tara (ML): Add QA caveat: run eval harness against critical prompts. Some instruction-tuned chat models show small regressions at 4-bit-compact. Link: https://go.redwood/evals

zack (Platform): Terraform snippet to help infra teams:
```hcl
variable "microbatch" { default = 6 }
resource "redwood_route" "main" { model = "rwd/llama-13b" quant_profile = "4bit-gamma" microbatch = var.microbatch }
```

anya (Docs): CLI snippet and one-line customer blurb please. I'll open PR branch docs/optkit/quick-quant-migration and keep it minimal.

mike (Eng-runtime): CLI: `redwoodctl deploy set-config --model rwd/llama-13b --quant-profile 4bit-gamma --microbatch 6`

zack (Platform): Also add this runtime policy option to prevent silent fallback:
```yaml
route_policy:
  quant_enforce: "fail_if_unavailable"
```

ci-bot: PR opened -> docs/optkit/quick-quant-migration (checks: lint, links).

anya (Docs): Perfect. I'll add a 3-line FAQ, the snippets, and a 2-point QA checklist: (1) run quick_eval.sh, (2) pin quant_profile for Dedicated if you need consistent outputs. Merge EOD Friday unless flagged.

tara (ML): :+1: I'll paste a 1-line perf note after a quick smoke run: expect ~1.7-1.9x throughput for 4-bit-gamma on our A10 trace, with caveats for some chat-family models.

anya (Docs) reaction: :sparkles:
